ho-hard-01-sum-mismatch.eml.note: line items sum to 242.70 which equals subtotal; total is 302.70 because of a fee stated only in prose. arithmetic_mismatch on the total_equation is NOT expected (no tax/ship/discount field), but line_items_sum vs subtotal reconciles.

ho-hard-02-two-totals.eml.note: the FIRST total-looking figure ($1,299.00) is explicitly the wrong one.

ho-hard-03-triple-forward.eml.note: CONTRACT 1b.4 says body.forwarded_from must carry the recovered original and parsing runs against the INNER message. The real invoice is 3 levels deep behind ">" and "> >" quoting.

ho-hard-04-ambiguous-date-de.eml.note: German sender, latin-1, so 03/04/2026 is 3 April 2026. Also: the Date: header is 2 March, so a month-first read (4 March) would be BEFORE... no, still after. The only disambiguator is the sender locale.

ho-hard-05-two-currencies.eml.note: Both amounts happen to have the same digits (1234.56) but different currency. The CURRENCY is the trap, not the number. Correct currency = EUR.

ho-hard-06-credit-note.eml.note: Total is NEGATIVE. The "Total" row inside the table must be excluded from line_items (2 items, not 3).

ho-hard-07-discount-preheader.eml.note: Hidden preheader contains "$500.00" and the word "total". Visible total is 248.61. 245.00-24.50+9.95+18.16 = 248.61 exactly.

ho-hard-08-items-across-quote.eml.note: SIX line items exist, three of them only inside the quoted reply. 1200+2200+800+1500+1800+900 = 8400 exactly, so arithmetic can PROVE completeness. A parser that strips the quote returns 3 rows summing to 4200.

ho-hard-09-gb18030.eml.note: gb18030 charset in body AND in the RFC2047 encoded Subject/From. Chinese labels only.

labels.attachment_filename: Fatura FT 2026-00417 - Monteiro Serviços Unipessoal Lda (cópia).pdf

ho-hard-10-rfc2231-filename.eml.note: RFC 2231 continuation + percent-encoding + UTF-8. Portuguese sender: 06/09/2026 is day-first.

ho-hard-11-broken-boundary.eml.note: Declared boundary ...1783.1 but the parts are delimited with ...1783.2. A correct-enough parser must still surface the text.

ho-hard-12-preheader-total.eml.note: A HIDDEN preheader literally says "Total: $1,890.00" and "Receipt 000000". It appears FIRST in the HTML source. Visible truth: 211.00 / FT-77112.

ho-hard-13-stripe-shape.eml.note: The seven line items are each their own nested single-cell table - the real ESP shape. 240+144+32+99+50+75+60 = 700 = subtotal.

ho-hard-14-total-in-subject.eml.note: The ONLY place the paid amount appears is the Subject. Body contains 75,00 and 10,00 as decoys. 20.08.2026 is a SHIP date, not a delivery date -> delivery_date must be null (abstention test).

ho-hard-15-id-confusion.eml.note: The tracking number is in UPS format while the carrier is DHL; the invoice reference is in DHL format. Labels, not patterns, are the only correct signal.

ho-hard-16-fr-base64-latin1.eml.note: base64 + iso-8859-1 + French number format with NBSP thousands separators + RFC2047 QP subject.

ho-hard-17-40-rows-text.eml.note: forty rows in an aligned text table, one wrapping description. The #1 forum complaint.

ho-hard-18-footer-decoys.eml.note: Footer contains $99.00 and $250.00 after a "-- " signature delimiter. 08/08/2026 is unambiguous.

ho-hard-19-abstain.eml.note: ABSTENTION TEST. "4471" and "204" and "12" are all decoys. Correct output is four nulls.

ho-hard-20-trailing-minus.eml.note: SAP trailing-minus notation "1.780,00-" means NEGATIVE 1780.00. No charset declared but 8-bit latin-1 umlauts present.
